runtimeControls.SourceDemo.stop(): Pause this effect ticker and its tweens; release current capture.
runtimeControls.SourceDemo.resume(): Resume only allowed native motion; never overrides reduced motion.
runtimeControls.SourceDemo.paint(): Render the current state without advancing time or fabricating input; returns readiness.
runtimeControls.SourceDemo.dispose(): Idempotently release current effect and local transport resources; new playback requires new frame.
runtimeControls.SourceDemo.inspect(): Return effect-only state and asset counts; no parent data.

readiness: ready true only after six original images loaded and current render submitted. It does not prove visual/browser acceptance.

interaction.type: native pointer horizontal drag with inertia
interaction.reducedMotion: no autoplay/entrance/time drift; direct drag without fling
